### 1. Aesthetic & Material Strategy for White Walls + Gray Floors

When an 89m² 3-bedroom apartment features cool-toned base finishes—specifically pure white walls (乳胶漆/白墙) and gray tile or gray laminate floors (灰色地砖/灰木地板)—the space can feel sterile, cold, or overly industrial if not balanced properly [2, 3]. To create an inviting, modern, and warm living environment without undergoing major structural alterations, soft furnishings must act as the visual and tactile warmth regulators [2, 3].

#### A. Color Palette Matching Strategy
*   **Primary Foundation (60%):** White walls and gray flooring provide a high-brightness, neutral background canvas.
*   **Secondary Softening Tones (30%):** Introduce warm neutrals to offset the cool gray ground. Recommended core colors include Cream White (奶白色), Oatmeal/Beige (燕麦色/米杏色), Greige (暖灰/灰棕色), and Warm Taupe.
*   **Accent & Contrast Tones (10%):** Incorporate warm organic accents such as Caramel/Amber (焦糖色/琥珀色), Muted Terracotta (瓦松红/陶土色), Olive Green (橄榄绿), or Warm Walnut Brown (胡桃木色) in throw pillows, ceramics, artwork, and single armchairs.

#### B. Material Layering & Tactile Warmth
*   **Upholstery & Fabrics:** Avoid cold, slick artificial leather across all seating. Instead, mix textures:
    *   *Bouclé (羊羔绒/特种纱):* Provides high tactile depth and softness for single chairs or accent cushions.
    *   *Chenille / High-density Cotton-Linen (雪尼尔/高密棉麻):* Excellent for sofas and drapes due to their soft drape, subtle sheen, and skin-friendly texture.
    *   *Saddle Leather / Top-grain Napa Leather (鞍马皮/头层黄牛皮):* Introduces natural warmth and luxury when used on accent lounge chairs or coffee table trays.
*   **Wood Accents:** Introduce North American White Oak (白橡木) for a brighter Cream/Japandi look, or North American Black Walnut (黑胡桃木) for a sophisticated, grounded Modern Minimalist look [4]. Wood elements (dining tables, TV consoles, bed frames) break up the continuous expanse of gray floor tiles [4].
*   **Metals & Hard Surfaces:** Replace cold mirror-finish chrome or high-gloss silver stainless steel with Matte Brushed Brass (哑光拉丝黄铜), Anodized Gunmetal Grey (枪灰色哑光金属), or Textured Ceramic/Sintered Stone (哑光岩板) with natural warm veining.

#### C. Lighting Temperature & Layering
*   **Color Temperature:** Maintain a unified color temperature between **3000K (Warm White) and 3500K (Neutral Warm)** throughout the living and sleeping areas. Avoid harsh 5000K-6000K cool white light which amplifies the coldness of gray tiles.
*   **Layered Lighting:** Supplement ceiling lights with floor lamps, under-cabinet LED strip lights (2700K-3000K), and bedside pendant lamps to throw warm wall washes over white vertical surfaces.

    *   *Price Range:* ¥4,500 – ¥9,000.
    *   *Best Suited For:* Modern urban design enthusiasts seeking distinct silhouette forms.
*   **Linshi Home (林氏家居 / 林氏木业):** Fast-furniture leader offering broad style selections, high cost-performance ratio, and modular layouts [4, 5, 6].
    *   *Price Range:* ¥2,200 – ¥4,500 [4, 5, 6].
    *   *Best Suited For:* Budget-conscious buyers or secondary bedrooms [4, 5, 6].
*   **IKEA (宜家):** Modular sofas (e.g., SÖDERHAMN / LANDSKRONA) with washable slipcovers and customizable configurations.

# 89㎡ Modern Home Soft Furnishing Allocation Plan & Shopping Guide

This comprehensive soft furnishing allocation plan and shopping recommendation guide is tailored for a newly renovated 89㎡ apartment with a 3-bedroom, 1-living-room layout. Featuring a modern hard-furnishing foundation—pure white latex paint walls and gray floor tiles—this guide establishes a balanced budget distribution of **¥100,000 RMB** across furniture, appliances, and soft decor.

---

## 1. Budget Allocation Strategy (¥100,000 Total)

A total budget of ¥100,000 RMB requires a rational distribution strategy to prevent overspending on major appliances while under-budgeting for daily contact pieces like sofas and mattresses [10, 11]. For an 89㎡ 3-bedroom layout, the budget is split across three core categories: **Furniture (48%)**, **Major Home Appliances (34%)**, and **Soft Decor, Lighting & Textiles (18%)** [11].

```
================================================================================
TOTAL SOFT FURNISHING BUDGET: ¥100,000 RMB
================================================================================
1. Main Furniture Package (主家具包):              ¥48,000 RMB  (48.0%)
2. Major Home Appliances (大家电包):            ¥34,000 RMB  (34.0%)
3. Soft Decor, Lighting & Curtains (软装与灯具包): ¥18,000 RMB  (18.0%)
================================================================================
```

| **Total Allocation** | **¥48,000** | **¥34,000** | **¥18,000** | **¥100,000** |

---

## 2. Design & Material Strategy for White Walls & Gray Floors

Cool base finishes—specifically bright white walls and light/medium gray tile flooring—can create an overly cold, clinical atmosphere if soft furnishings are not carefully curated [11, 12]. Soft furnishings must act as visual and tactile "warmth regulators" to transform the space into a cozy, modern living environment [12].

```
================================================================================
COLOR PALETTE STRATEGY (60-30-10 RULE)
================================================================================
[ 60% Base Canvas ]   Pure White Walls + Gray Tile Floors
[ 30% Warm Neutrals ] Cream White, Oatmeal, Beige, Warm Greige (Sofas/Drapes/Rugs)
[ 10% Warm Accents  ] Caramel, Amber, Terracotta, FAS Walnut (Pillows/Wood/Art)
================================================================================
```

### A. Color Palette Matching Strategy
* **Base Foundation (60%):** White walls and gray flooring provide a high-brightness, neutral canvas [12].
* **Softening Tones (30%):** Introduce warm neutral tones to counteract the cold floor. Recommended shades include Cream White (奶白色), Oatmeal/Beige (燕麦色/米杏色), and Warm Greige (暖灰) across sofas, curtains, and large area rugs [11, 12].
* **Accent & Contrast Tones (10%):** Layer rich, organic accent colors such as Caramel/Amber (焦糖色/琥珀色), Terracotta (陶土色), and Warm Walnut Brown (胡桃木色) through throw pillows, solid wood accents, artwork, and decorative ceramics [13].

### B. Tactile Layering & Material Selection
* **Upholstery & Textiles:** Avoid shiny or cold artificial leather across all seating [13]. Blend tactile fabrics like **Bouclé (羊羔绒)** for accent chairs, **Chenille (雪尼尔)** or high-density cotton-linen for main sofas and drapes, and **Top-grain Napa Leather (头层牛皮)** in warm brown tones for armchairs [13].
* **Wood Tones:** Integrate **North American FAS-grade White Oak (白橡木)** for a bright Japandi/Cream aesthetic or **North American Black Walnut (黑胡桃木)** for a refined Modern Minimalist aesthetic [13]. Wood surfaces (dining tables, TV consoles, platform beds) break up continuous expanses of gray tile [13].
* **Metals & Hard Surfaces:** Replace cold mirror-finish chrome with **Matte Brushed Brass (哑光拉丝黄铜)**, **Anodized Gunmetal Grey (枪灰色哑光金属)**, or **Sintered Stone (岩板)** featuring warm cream/gold veining [12].

### C. Lighting Temperature Strategy
* **Standard Color Temperature:** Maintain a strict color temperature between **3000K (Warm White) and 3500K (Neutral Warm)** throughout living and sleeping zones. Avoid 5000K–6000K cool white lighting, which accentuates the coldness of gray tiles [12].
* **Layered Ambient Lighting:** Pair deep-recessed anti-glare COB spotlights with under-cabinet LED cove lighting (2700K–3000K) and floor lamps to cast warm light washes over white vertical surfaces [12].

---

## 3. Major Home Appliances Recommendation Guide

### A. Refrigerator Selection (Ultra-Thin / Zero-Distance Embedded)
In an 89㎡ layout, kitchen space is often compact (typically 5㎡–7㎡). Standard refrigerators with depths of 700mm–750mm protrude past standard 600mm kitchen countertops, blocking walkways. The optimal solution is a **Zero-Distance Flat-Embedded Refrigerator (零嵌/平嵌冰箱)** with a body depth of ~594mm–600mm, bottom/front heat dissipation, and 90° flush door hinges [3, 6].

```

|   Standard Cabinet Depth: 600mm                                         |

|   Ultra-Thin Refrigerator Body: 594mm - 600mm                           |
|   [=================================================================]   |
|   Result: 0cm Side Gap / Flush Front Profile (No Protrusion)            |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Recommended Refrigerator Models:

   * **Dimensions (W×D×H):** 852mm × 600mm × 1912mm (Body depth: 598mm) [4, 7].
   * **Capacity:** 508L (Refrigeration: 325L, Freezer: 183L) [4, 7].
   * **Cooling Tech:** Dual evaporators / Dual cooling system (双系统风冷无霜) to eliminate odor transfer between compartments [4, 7].

   * **CP Rating:** **8.8/10**. A reliable benchmark model for 60cm cabinet integration [6].

### B. Laundry Solutions (Washer & Dryer Stacks vs. Combos)
For an 89㎡ apartment balcony, a dedicated **Variable-Frequency Heat Pump Washer & Dryer Stack (变频热泵洗烘套装)** stacked vertically is strongly recommended over a single washer-dryer combo unit [1, 2]. Heat pump drying operates at low temperatures (56°C), preventing fabric shrinkage, offering better lint collection, and consuming less energy [1, 2].

